notes:
BUU v3.2.1 - crash recovery + reliable scheduled-run emails.

Two fixes from the 07-29 run.

Renderer crashes no longer cascade. When a worker's browser ran out of memory after hours of work, the worker used to keep reusing the dead page and error out every remaining row (one run lost 8,207 rows with no recovery). Now a crash retires that one worker cleanly and its in-flight row is handed back and re-run on a fresh worker. Guards: a single account/row that keeps crashing workers is skipped after a few tries so it can't take the pool down a worker at a time, and repeated crashes from memory pressure lower the worker count and HOLD it there for the rest of the run instead of refilling into the same wall.

Memory is now watched live. Every ~2-minute check re-measures free RAM and each worker's real footprint (the browser plus all of its child processes) and retires any worker that has bloated past the limit, bringing up a fresh one so its memory resets - BEFORE it can crash. Tunable via workerMemThresholdMB in config (default 1500 MB; 0 turns it off).

Scheduled-run emails always fire now. A scheduled run that finished quickly between the old 30-second status checks was wrongly marked "never started" and sent no email, while slower runs did email. Completion is now detected the instant the run actually ends, no matter how fast or slow it was, with a backstop at the end of the reserved time block that keeps re-checking (using the live time-remaining estimate) until the run is done - then sends the email if it hasn't already gone out, for both success and failure.
